name: Callosa de Segura (Spain)
description: Dark red field charged at the centre with the full achievement of the arms of Callosa de Segura (a dog beside a burning pine on yellow, with flags, drums and foliage).
history: The arms show on a gold field a green pine wrapped in flames with a dog tied to it.

features.role: Callosa de Segura arms — dog and burning pine with trophies
